sentences.text: Islamabad -LRB- -LSB- ɪzˈlɑːməˌbɑːd -RSB- -LSB- , , -LSB- ɪsˌlɑːmɑˈbɑːd̪ -RSB- -RRB- is the capital city of Pakistan located within the federal Islamabad Capital Territory .	Territory	Administrative units of Pakistan	Islamabad Capital Territory	Islamabad Capital Territory	Pakistan	Pakistan

With a population of two million , it is the 10th largest city of Pakistan , while the larger Islamabad-Rawalpindi metropolitan area is the third largest in Pakistan with a population exceeding five million .	Pakistan	Pakistan	10th largest	List of most populous cities in Pakistan	Islamabad-Rawalpindi metropolitan area	Islamabad-Rawalpindi metropolitan area

The city is the political seat of Pakistan and is administered by the Islamabad Metropolitan Corporation , supported by the Capital Development Authority -LRB- CDA -RRB- .	Islamabad Metropolitan Corporation	Islamabad Metropolitan Corporation	Capital Development Authority	Capital Development Authority	Pakistan	Pakistan

Islamabad is located in the Pothohar Plateau in the northeastern part of the country , between Rawalpindi District and the Margalla Hills National Park to the north .	Margalla Hills National Park	Margalla Hills National Park	Pothohar Plateau	Pothohar Plateau	Rawalpindi District	Rawalpindi District

The region has historically been a part of the crossroads of Punjab and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa with the Margalla Pass acting as the gateway between the two regions .	Punjab	Punjab, Pakistan	Khyber Pakhtunkhwa	Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Islamabad was built during the 1960s to replace Karachi as Pakistan 's capital .	Pakistan	Pakistan	Karachi	Karachi

The city 's master-plan divides the city into eight zones , including administrative , diplomatic enclave , residential areas , educational sectors , industrial sectors , commercial areas , and rural and green areas .

The city is known for the presence of several parks and forests , including the Margalla Hills National Park and Shakarparian Park .	Margalla Hills National Park	Margalla Hills National Park	Shakarparian Park	Shakarparian

The city is home to several landmarks , including the Faisal Mosque , the largest mosque in South Asia and the fourth largest in the world .	Faisal Mosque	Faisal Mosque	largest mosque	List of mosques in Pakistan	fourth largest	List of largest mosques
Other landmarks include the Pakistan 's National Monument and Democracy Square .	Pakistan	Pakistan	Democracy Square	D-Chowk (Islamabad)

Islamabad is a beta - world city ; it is categorised as very high on the Human Development Index , the highest in the country .	very high	List of districts of Pakistan by Human Development Index	Human Development Index	Human Development Index

The city has the highest cost of living in Pakistan , and its population is dominated by middle and upper middle class citizens .	Pakistan	Pakistan	cost of living	cost of living	middle	Middle class	upper middle	Upper middle class

The city is home to sixteen universities , including the Quaid-e-Azam University and NUST .	Quaid-e-Azam University	Quaid-i-Azam University	NUST	National University of Sciences and Technology, Pakistan
The city is one of the safest in Pakistan , and has an expansive surveillance system with 1,900 CCTV cameras .	Pakistan	Pakistan	CCTV	CCTV
